2608.08189.title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets
2608.08189.paper_summary: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware execution, or physical experiments, making each evaluation expensive. Cheap surrogate evaluators can reduce this cost, yet fixed surrogates are vulnerable to search-induced distribution shift and are difficult to fit reliably from sparse, search-biased labels. We introduce Janus, a framework that uses LLMs to co-evolve target programs and executable proxy evaluators. To address label scarcity, Janus leverages domain knowledge encoded in LLMs to generate task-specific evaluator programs and calibrates them using real outcomes. To mitigate distribution shift, Janus evolves evaluators alongside target programs, selects them using a promotion-aligned objective, and maintains region-conditioned portfolios with online credit updates. Because proxy predictions remain fallible, Janus uses them only to prioritize candidates and requires real validation before candidates can enter the target-program population or update the incumbent. Across five scientific and engineering design tasks, Janus achieves a larger area under the best-so-far improvement curve over the real-evaluation budget and higher final performance than a matched baseline that evolves only target programs. On average, Janus reaches 99/% of the baseline's final improvement with 59.1/% fewer real evaluations. Evolved proxy evaluators also rank promising candidates more accurately than their seed versions. Together, these results extend evaluator-guided LLM discovery from tasks with cheap, scalable feedback to scientific domains where trustworthy evaluation is scarce and expensive.
2608.08189.paper_summary_zh: LLM 驅動的程式發現依賴於快速的評估者反饋，但許多科學和工程任務需要高保真度的模擬、硬體執行或實體實驗，使得每次評估都變得昂貴。便宜的替代評估者可以降低這一成本，然而固定的替代評估者易受搜索引起的分佈變化影響，並且難以從稀疏的、受搜索偏見的標籤中可靠地擬合。我們介紹了 Janus，一個使用 LLM 共同演化目標程式和可執行代理評估者的框架。為了解決標籤稀缺的問題，Janus 利用編碼在 LLM 中的領域知識來生成特定任務的評估者程式，並使用實際結果對其進行校準。為了減輕分佈變化，Janus 在目標程式的演化過程中演化評估者，並使用與推廣對齊的目標來選擇它們，並保持帶有在線信用更新的區域條件投資組合。由於代理預測仍然存在不可靠性，Janus 只使用它們來優先考慮候選者，並要求在候選者可以進入目標程式群體或更新現任者之前進行實際驗證。在五個科學和工程設計任務中，Janus 在真實評估預算下實現了最佳改進曲線下的更大面積，並且最終表現高於僅演化目標程式的匹配基準。平均而言，Janus 在實際評估上減少了 59.1/% 的次數，達到了基準最終改進的 99/%。演化的代理評估者也比其種子版本更準確地排名有前景的候選者。總體而言，這些結果將評估者引導的 LLM 發現從具有便宜、可擴展反饋的任務擴展到可信評估稀缺且昂貴的科學領域。
